##### Project general facts

Isolana Residences by Hayaat Developments is a distinctive waterfront address set within Dubai Islands, where architecture is shaped by movement, light, and a strong connection to nature. Designed by Tony Ashai, the building is defined by fluid balconies and a sculptural façade that reflects the rhythm of wind and sea. The project offers a refined collection of residences, from one-bedroom apartments to expansive four-bedroom penthouses, all thoughtfully designed to create a calm, contemporary living environment rooted in natural harmony.

The lifestyle at Isolana is centered around wellness, leisure, and a sense of community. Residents are welcomed by a grand double-height lobby and enjoy access to a curated range of amenities, including an infinity pool, zen garden, paddle court, fully equipped gym, children’s play areas, and elegant lounge spaces. Surrounded by landscaped parks and green open areas, the development creates a tranquil, resort-like atmosphere while remaining closely connected to beaches, marinas, and key urban destinations.

Interiors are finished with a refined palette of natural materials, combining stone, wood, textured plaster, and marble accents to create a warm and sophisticated ambiance. Spaces are designed with soft tones and organic textures, enhancing the sense of comfort and balance throughout each residence. Apartments feature equipped kitchens, built-in wardrobes, and semi-furnished layouts, offering a seamless blend of functionality and understated elegance ready for modern living.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Islands offers diverse island living and a vacation-inspired lifestyle, an array of luxury resort offerings, village centres with services and entertainment, elite wellness & sports venues, beautiful beaches for water sports, and vibrant green spaces for outdoor leisure pursuits.

A magnificent group of five islands located to the north of the city, Dubai Islands offers over 50km of stunning waterfront homes and hotels in an idyllic setting that connects sandy shores, inviting water edges and world-class amenities to the mainland via the striking Infinity Bridge.

This contemporary landscaped residential development boasts beautiful Residences of apartment and villa typologies, an on-site Rixos hotel, and an extensive array of enviable amenities dedicated to the Residence owners, including stunning pools, lush green garden terraces, and a pristine beachfront. Residents will enjoy a world of wellness activities and water sports combined with the services of the all- exclusive Rixos in a friendly resort- style neighbourhood.
